messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: sudden spike in 5xxs and gateway timeouts across inference-gateway (us-west-2) starting 2026-03-10T03:02:10Z. 5xx rate ~18% (normal ~0.4%). 429 surge seen at ~03:01:40. Metrics: https://metrics.redwood/alerts/1718004321

Alice K.: I'm oncall — acknowledging and declaring Sev2. Paging SRE/infra. @pager-duty please page oncall.

pager-duty: Paging Ben T. (SRE oncall) — please acknowledge.

Ben T.: here. looking at alerts/logs. any recent infra or config pushes?

Carla M.: There was a config push to global-quota at ~03:00 by ops-automation. It tightened default enforcement for tenant buckets.

Ben T.: can we get the rollout id and a quick traffic breakdown by tenant? want to see who is speaking to gateway.

Carla M.: tail from rate-limiter: 
```
2026-03-10T03:01:35Z INFO apply-quota tenant=acme tokens=0 policy=global-default
2026-03-10T03:01:36Z WARN throttle tenant=acme reason=quota-exhausted route=/v1/generate 429
2026-03-10T03:01:37Z ERROR gateway timeout route=/v1/generate status=504 backend=model-serving-12
```
Looks like strict quota enforcement created 429s, clients retried aggressively, backend became overloaded -> 504/5xx.

Dave R.: @Ben, need customer impact ASAP — which tenants, SLA hits, any enterprise customers affected?

Ben T.: initial list: acme (highest errors), finbox, playstack. Acme is on Dedicated but still proxied through gateway for auth flows. Finbox has degraded experience.

Alice K.: quick mitigation plan:
1) rollback global-quota to previous defaults (fast)
2) enable soft-queue behavior for 429s to smooth retry storms (30s max)
3) temporarily scale model-serving pool and route most critical tenants to isolated pool
4) notify impacted customers and CSMs

Carla M.: I can run rollback: `kubectl -n infra rollout undo configmap/global-quota --to-revision=3` — need ops approval to execute.

Ben T.: I authorize. running rollback.

ops-bot: exec: kubectl -n infra rollout undo configmap/global-quota --to-revision=3
ops-bot: result: success — configmap restored to revision 3 (applied by Ben T.)

Ben T.: rollback applied. monitoring.

(2m later) Alice K.: metrics update: 5xx dropped from 18% -> 6% and continuing downward. 429s reduced sharply.

Carla M.: deployed gateway soft-queue patch: 
PATCH /gateway/config 
{ "retry_policy": { "on_429": "soft_queue", "queue_max_seconds": 30 }}
ops-bot: gateway-config v12 patched — deploy OK.

Ben T.: scaled model-serving pool (manual autoscale override + 4 nodes). new instances healthy.

(5m later) Alice K.: overall 5xx now ~1.2% and trending to baseline. Reducing pager noise, keeping incident active until stable for 30m.

Dave R.: drafting customer-facing note: explain quota misconfig, rollback performed, offer follow-up postmortem. tagging solutions and CSMs for ACME/Finbox.

Carla M.: root cause timeline: ops-automation PR merged 2026-03-10T02:59:12Z (commit a8d3fc4). rollout started 02:59:45Z -> global effect on tenant buckets, staging/canary gating absent.

Ben T.: action items (initial): rollback (done), add canary staging for quota changes (Carla), tenant-level opt-out for strict defaults (Product/Dave), add 429->soft-queue in runbook (SRE), run retry-storm capacity tests (Infra).

Alice K.: assigning: Carla M. (canary + runbook note), Dave R. (tenant opt-out spec + comms), Ben T. (post-incident load test + dashboard improvements), Alice K. (incident writeup + schedule postmortem).

Carla M.: will open PR for staged rollout and add CI test coverage.

Ben T.: observed secondary issue: some client libraries immediately retry on 429 w/o proper backoff. Recommend SDK default backoff and guidance.

Dave R.: cc @account-sdks — please add recommended exponential backoff in SDKs and docs. Carla will file a ticket.

Carla M.: created ticket #INC-1284 for canary quota rollout. Dave R.: #INC-1285 tenant opt-out spec. Ben T.: #INC-1286 client-backoff guidance + load test.

(20m) ops-bot: monitoring update: svc=inference-gateway 5xx=0.9% 429=0.2% (5m window).

Alice K.: lowering severity to Sev3. Incident stays open for follow-ups. Thanks for the quick coordination. :thumbsup: 

Ben T.: collecting final timeline and commit info for postmortem.

Carla M.: commit a8d3fc4 — merged by ops-automation 2026-03-10T02:59:12Z. Rollout start 02:59:45Z.

Alice K.: scheduling a postmortem sync tomorrow 09:00 UTC. I'll include error minutes, affected tenants, and estimated impact.

Dave R.: sending customer comms drafts to ACME/Finbox CSMs now.

Ben T.: closing pager. Re-open if anything spikes.

pager-duty: Incident acknowledged closed by Ben T.

Alice K.: post-incident reminders: add automated canary gating for configmap changes, instrument per-tenant error attribution, and add runway for retry-throttling in gateway. I'll capture these in the writeup.

(45m) Alice K.: final — total duration ~28 minutes, peak affected tenants 3, peak 5xx 18%. Leaving thread open for PM/sales attachments and postmortem links. Thanks all. :heart:
